_readme: Addons the app can browse from GitHub without an API key. Add an entry with the repo, the name to show, a category from wow/addons/AddonCategory.kt and a short summary; the nightly 'Addon catalog' workflow fills in versions, Forever/Classic files and download links. Only repos whose GitHub releases ship zips (ideally with a packager release.json) work.
